groups.problem: validate_timestamp/validate_age check the other field by truthiness, so a value of 0 slips past the age/timestamp mutual-exclusion check.
groups.rationale: Both point at the same validators and describe the same falsy-0 bypass. Both suggest the same key-presence fix.

groups.problem: fetch_error_details pairs error_ids with nodestore get_multi results by position using zip, so error ids can end up matched with the wrong event data.
groups.rationale: All three flag the same zip(error_ids, events.values()) line. Whether the cause is reordering, dedupe or missing entries, each fixes it the same way: look up the data by node id.

groups.problem: The feature-flagged TableWidgetVisualization branch is rendered with hardcoded empty columns and tableData, so the real query results are thrown away.
groups.rationale: Both describe the same placeholder props in chart.tsx (lines 164-174) that give an empty table.
